source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-20: The Overthrow of Ambition

items.name: Chthonic Cloud
items.text: Creatures inside the swarm's space are Concealed from creatures outside of its space, and vice versa.

items.name: Disgusting Chorus
items.text:
20 feet. The swarm's component members cry out, crawling all over everything and everyone with sickening sounds and limbs. Creatures who enter or begin their turns inside the aura must attempt a DC 25 Fortitude save save. Once a creature has been targeted by this ability, regardless of the result, they are temporarily immune to Disgusting Chorus for 1 hour.

---
Success No effect.

Failure The creature becomes Sickened 1, and cannot reduce their sickened condition below 1 while inside the swarm's space.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Sickened 2, and cannot reduce their sickened condition below 1 while inside the swarm's space.

items.name: Feast on Flesh
items.text: The swarm pulls at flesh just as locusts strip away vegetation. Each enemy in the swarm's space must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save save or take 3d6 persistent,bleed damage.

items.name: Swallowed Foulness
items.text:
Trigger A creature begins its turn inside the swarm's space and isn't holding its breath

---
Effect Individual insects swarm down the creature's throat and explode, dealing them 1 acid damage and requiring them to make a DC 25 Will save save.

---
Success No effect.

Failure The creature becomes Stupefied 1 until the end of their current turn as they recover from the disgusting experience.

Critical Failure As success, but until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Thousands of Teeth
items.text: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d10 piercing damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save)
